meta.source: sweetandfizzy.com live CSS (Oxygen universal.css and page CSS), read 2026-10-18

tokens.name: fizz-yellow
tokens.usage: Brand color. The Imagine process tab, card borders and headers, and the nav hover underline. Carries `ink-on-brand` text (15.7:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: fizz-blue
tokens.usage: Brand color. The Design process tab, card headers and the button family. Carries `ink-on-brand` text (8.9:1). Readable as text on `surface` in charcoal sections (6.7:1).

tokens.name: fizz-orange
tokens.usage: Brand color. The Build process tab and card headers. Carries `ink-on-brand` text (7.0:1). Readable as text only on charcoal (5.3:1), never on light grey (1.9:1).

tokens.name: tab-grey
tokens.usage: The fourth process tab (AI) on the current site. Carries `ink-on-brand` text (8.6:1).

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Logo only: the blue offset on the ampersand. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: logo-yellow
tokens.usage: Logo only: the yellow offset on the ampersand. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: logo-orange
tokens.usage: Logo only: the orange offset on the ampersand. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground. Light sections run a gradient from `surface-raised` at the top to `surface` at 100%; charcoal sections are flat. Redesign: white for reading sections; Redesign band: blue-cast charcoal for the hero and occasional bands.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Light: the top of the section gradient and the header band. Charcoal: the lighter band used for the hosting call-out. Redesign: the cool off-white for alternating sections (ink 14.5:1). Redesign band: a raised panel on the band.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Light: the process tab content panel. Charcoal: the footer band, a hair off `surface`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Service card body in every section. Text on it is `ink-on-brand` (21:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-panel` (13:1 or better in both themes). Also the focus ring color. Redesign: blue-cast charcoal on white and off-white (14.5:1 or better); Redesign band: white (13:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on `fizz-yellow`, `fizz-blue`, `fizz-orange` and `card`, in both themes. Redesign: blue-cast charcoal on the brand colors (5.3:1 on orange, 6.7:1 on blue, 11.8:1 on yellow).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Redesign: secondary text, captions and author lists on `surface` and `surface-raised` (7.0:1 or better light, 7.9:1 or better on the band).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Redesign: decorative dividers and the screenshot frame border. Not for control borders, which use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: audience-research
tokens.usage: Redesign: the research computing audience. Hero slide, offer card, section accents and the Connect.CI and AI agents pages. Fill only on light grounds; text uses `audience-research-text`.

tokens.name: audience-research-text
tokens.usage: Redesign: research computing eyebrows and links as text (8.2:1 or better on light, 5.5:1 or better on the band).

tokens.name: audience-startup
tokens.usage: Redesign: the startup audience. Hero slide, offer card and the Build your business page. Fill only on light grounds; text uses `audience-startup-text`.

tokens.name: audience-startup-text
tokens.usage: Redesign: startup eyebrows and links as text (5.7:1 on white, 5.3:1 on the band).

tokens.name: audience-community
tokens.usage: Redesign: organizations and community projects. Hero slide, offer card and creative work. Fill only; yellow is never text on light grounds, so its eyebrows use `ink`.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Current button fill with white uppercase text. White on it is 3.1:1, below the 4.5:1 floor for 16px text. Kept exact from the live site; see `button-proposed`.

tokens.name: button-hover
tokens.usage: Current button hover fill. White on it is 6.6:1.

tokens.name: button-proposed
tokens.usage: Proposed for the redesign: buttons in `fizz-blue` with `ink-on-brand` text (8.9:1), hover to `button-hover` with white text. Fixes the current contrast miss and keeps the brand blue.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Current link color everywhere. 3.9:1 on white, 2.9:1 on `surface-raised`, 4.0:1 on charcoal: below 4.5:1 on every ground. Kept exact; see `link-proposed`.

tokens.name: link-proposed
tokens.usage: Proposed for the redesign: links in light sections in deep blue, in charcoal sections in `fizz-blue`. Light passes on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-panel` (5.6:1 or better); dark passes on charcoal `surface` and `surface-panel` (6.6:1) but not on the `surface-raised` band (4.1:1), where links use `ink` with an underline.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section titles, set uppercase. One per section, centered or left with the section.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page hero line, set uppercase on charcoal.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Service card headers on a brand color, set uppercase.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small headings inside cards and panels.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We start by asking the right questions to uncover your needs.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs in panels, max 640px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We have experience and creativity that can help you.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The face the logo is drawn in. Use the logo files, not live type, for the brand name; never for running text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: From answering questions to submitting jobs.
styles.usage: Redesign: hero headlines, sentence case. One per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Your budget goes to what is new
styles.usage: Redesign: section headlines, sentence case, left aligned on deep pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Redesign: card and case study titles, sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Redesign: the only uppercase text besides buttons. Small labels above headlines, in the audience's text color.

tokens.name: space-button-y
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-button-x
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every section and the header.

tokens.name: space-heading
tokens.usage: Gap under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked items such as work images.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of section content and the header.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Redesign: max width of running text on deep pages, left aligned.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Service cards, process tabs (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Redesign: screenshot frames and diagrams.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Service cards and the process panel.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The colored top of each process tab.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Redesign: hover state for cards and buttons, with a 2px rise, in place of the 1.1 scale.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Redesign: resting shadow under screenshot frames.
